Contrast Security

Applications, vulnerability findings and libraries for a Contrast Security organization

skills/toil/contrast.md

Applications, vulnerability findings (traces) and libraries for one Contrast Security organization, through the TeamServer “ng” REST API (/Contrast/api/ng/<orgUuid>/...), on SaaS or self-hosted. Every command reads; none changes anything. Verification level: unit.

Supported versions: The oldest Contrast TeamServer version toil supports hasn’t been established. toil calls the TeamServer “ng” REST API with an API key and a service key. No release has been verified yet.

Credential

Three values, all from User Settings → Your Keys in Contrast: your username, the organization’s API key and your service key, plus the organization UUID shown on the same page. toil sends two headers on every request:

  • Authorization: base64(username:serviceKey), with no Basic prefix, which is Contrast’s own format
  • API-Key: <apiKey>

There is no password or browser login. A redirect to another host is refused, so the API key never leaves the configured instance.

Configuration

KeyEnv varRequiredMeaning
baseUrlTOIL_CONTRAST_BASE_URLyesInstance root, e.g. https://contrast.imagile.dev or https://app.contrastsecurity.com
orgUuidTOIL_CONTRAST_ORG_UUIDyesOrganization UUID
usernameTOIL_CONTRAST_USERNAMEyesContrast username
apiKeyTOIL_CONTRAST_API_KEYyesOrganization API key (secret)
serviceKeyTOIL_CONTRAST_SERVICE_KEYyesYour service key (secret)

There’s no CI fallback variable.

Environment variables (CI, or a one-off shell):

export TOIL_CONTRAST_BASE_URL=https://contrast.imagile.dev
export TOIL_CONTRAST_ORG_UUID=abc12345-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
export TOIL_CONTRAST_USERNAME=you@example.com
export TOIL_CONTRAST_API_KEY=<your API key>
export TOIL_CONTRAST_SERVICE_KEY=<your service key>

Or ~/.toil/config.json:

{
  "version": 2,
  "connections": {
    "corp-contrast": {
      "area": "contrast",
      "baseUrl": "https://contrast.imagile.dev",
      "orgUuid": "abc12345-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "username": "you@example.com"
    }
  },
  "defaults": { "contrast": { "connection": "corp-contrast" } }
}

apiKey and serviceKey never go in this file; a plaintext one there is refused with CONFIG_INVALID. Run toil connections add corp-contrast --area contrast (or toil connections login corp-contrast for an existing connection) to keep them in the OS credential store, or set the env vars.

Commands

data is Contrast’s own response, as it came, except for libraries get.

  • apps list: List applications in the organization.
  • findings list: List vulnerability findings for an application (--app, required). --severity and --status are sent as severities and statuses, as typed; a comma list such as HIGH,CRITICAL keeps its commas.
  • findings get: Get details for a specific vulnerability finding (--app and --trace, both required).
  • libraries list: List libraries used by an application, as shown on the Libraries tab (--app, required).
  • libraries get: Get details for a specific library used by an application, by hash (--app and --hash, both required). It reads the application’s libraries 25 at a time until one’s hash matches exactly, or a page has fewer than 25, and returns that one library object. No match is NOT_FOUND. It stops with an error after 1,000 pages.

apps list, findings list and libraries list take --limit (default 25) and --offset (default 0), sent to the server as given; they return one page, and you page by hand. --app, --trace and the org UUID go into the URL path as typed.

toil contrast apps list --limit 50
toil contrast findings list --app abc12345-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL
toil contrast libraries get --app abc12345-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --hash 0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f00f1e2d3c

Settings at a glance

  • baseUrl required

    Contrast instance root, e.g. https://contrast.imagile.dev or https://app.contrastsecurity.com

    TOIL_CONTRAST_BASE_URL

  • orgUuid required

    Organization UUID

    TOIL_CONTRAST_ORG_UUID

  • username required

    Contrast username

    TOIL_CONTRAST_USERNAME

  • apiKey required secret

    Organization API key

    TOIL_CONTRAST_API_KEY

  • serviceKey required secret

    Your service key

    TOIL_CONTRAST_SERVICE_KEY

Commands at a glance

  • toil contrastapps list

    List applications in the organization

    MCP contrast_apps_list--limit <n>--offset <n>

  • toil contrastfindings list

    List vulnerability findings for an application

    MCP contrast_findings_list--app <app-id>--severity <level>--status <status>--limit <n>--offset <n>

  • toil contrastfindings get

    Get details for a specific vulnerability finding

    MCP contrast_findings_get--app <app-id>--trace <trace-id>

  • toil contrastlibraries list

    List libraries used by an application, as shown on the Libraries tab

    MCP contrast_libraries_list--app <app-id>--limit <n>--offset <n>

  • toil contrastlibraries get

    Get details for a specific library used by an application, by hash

    MCP contrast_libraries_get--app <app-id>--hash <library-hash>
